frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/hooks/useWebSocket.ts:83-95 — useEffect early-returns when handlerRef.current is undefined but only depends on [eventType, subscribe]; if the caller initially passes handler=undefined and later supplies one, the effect never re-runs and no subscription is ever created — silent realtime stall.

Comparable hook useWebSocketSubscriptions(line 142-159) uses eventTypesKey to force re-subscription, but the single-handler hook has no equivalent guard; suggestion: bail when handler is undefined and add `handler != null` to the dep tuple (or accept the function and inline ref-write inside the effect).

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/contexts/WebSocketContext.tsx:246-256 — effect calls service.connect() on auth.accessToken change, but WebSocketService.connect() (lib/websocket.ts:291-294) returns early when socket.readyState === OPEN, so the live socket keeps its old JWT after a refresh.

The api-server only validates the token at handshake (token query param in buildWebSocketUrl, lib/websocket.ts:88-96); when the original JWT expires the server-side session is dropped but the client thinks it's still connected. Fix: when the token changes while connected, call disconnect()+connect() (mirroring the manual reconnect() path on line 324-330).

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx:389-424 — initializeAuth: when storedUser is null but refreshTokenValue is present (e.g. user-key purged or USER_KEY write failed earlier), the code successfully refreshes both tokens but the `if (storedUser) setUser(storedUser)` branch at line 408 never fires, so the session ends with valid tokens in storage but isAuthenticated=false.

Consequence: user is silently logged-out despite a working refresh-token, and TanStack Query caches are not seeded. Fix options: (a) fetch /me after refresh to repopulate user, or (b) clear tokens when storedUser is missing so the next visit forces a fresh login.
